html:
/* Template:InfoCard/styles.css - shared by InfoGrid, InfoCard and Callout. No overflow hidden, so item hover cards can open outside. */
.aa-info-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
	gap: 10px;
	margin: 0.8em 0 1.2em;
}
.aa-info,
.aa-callout {
	--aa-info-accent: var(--aa-accent, #e28552);
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-edge, rgba(247, 240, 233, .12));
	border-left: 3px solid var(--aa-info-accent);
	border-radius: 10px;
	background: var(--aa-card, rgba(35, 30, 26, .8));
}
.aa-info-danger { --aa-info-accent: #d9604c; }
.aa-info-control { --aa-info-accent: #6aa7d8; }
.aa-info-heal { --aa-info-accent: #7fb35a; }
.aa-info-debuff { --aa-info-accent: #b58ad8; }
.aa-info-reward { --aa-info-accent: #e2b252; }
.aa-info { padding: 10px 14px 12px; min-width: 0; }
.aa-info-head {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: baseline;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 2px 10px;
}
.aa-info-title {
	font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
	font-size: 1.25rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.2;
	color: var(--aa-title, inherit);
}
.aa-info-tag {
	padding: 0 9px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-info-accent);
	border-radius: 999px;
	font-size: .72rem;
	letter-spacing: .04em;
	color: var(--aa-info-accent);
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.aa-info-text {
	margin-top: 4px;
	font-size: .92rem;
	line-height: 1.5;
}
.aa-callout {
	margin: 1em 0 1.2em;
	padding: 10px 16px 6px;
}
.aa-callout-title {
	font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
	font-size: 1.3rem;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--aa-info-accent);
}
.aa-callout-body ul { margin: .3em 0 .4em 1.2em; }
.aa-callout-body li { margin: .25em 0; }
.aa-callout-body li::marker { color: var(--aa-info-accent); }
.aa-info-wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
/* a RecipeBox inside a card takes the width of the card instead of its own 320px */
.aa-info .aa-recipebox {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	margin-top: 8px;
}
.aa-info .aa-recipebox .aa-rb {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	width: auto;
	max-width: 100%;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.aa-info-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
